name: Bell
source:
Bell in adult form. She is mostly using her child form to conserve her magic use. 
Bell first met the protagonist when she was in her adult form, and ended up falling in love with him at first sight. Bell then promptly decided to make protagonist into her apprentice.
Despite her decision, once Bell discovered that the protagonist is in fact the prince of the Holy Royal Family, she became to distance herself from him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=4120]Getchu[/url].]
